requirements_summary: Workload: real-time user search + asynchronous catalog reindex; Index scale: ~8M vectors, 768-d embeddings. Latency: target p95 end-to-end 120-150ms for search+rerank; Throughput: baseline 150 qps, seasonal peak 1200 qps. Cost: target <$0.02/query (embeddings + rerank) at baseline; require cost breakdown. Model prefs: open LLM/embedding models, support for quantized weights and fallback smaller variants. Routing: prefer capacity-aware routing with regional fallbacks. Caching: hot-prefix caching for popular queries, TTLs for seasonal SKUs. SLOs: availability >99.9% during peak; seamless fallback to cheaper model under load.
